transfer_window.basis: between the existing before-transfer readback completion and after-transfer readback start; command scheduling lies inside

underlay.scope: All underlay interfaces in existing -i any SLL2 captures, UDP involving either WireGuard port plus ICMP/ICMPv6. Raw packet contents, keys and raw addresses are never exported. Exact-IP hash matches are per occurrence; a mismatch can include route header changes.

member_to_node.scope: All filtered underlay traffic in the transfer window, including candidate discovery and ICMP. An unmatched unrelated egress is not a lost selected-peer packet.

node_to_member.scope: All filtered underlay traffic in the transfer window, including candidate discovery and ICMP. An unmatched unrelated egress is not a lost selected-peer packet.

transfers.first_unconfirmed_hop: none: original origin receipt and both device counter increments
